title: THURSDAY INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY. INTERVALS. OPEN THE CHEST AND HIPS, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN SHORT SHARP STATIONS ON THE STAIRS AND FLOOR. FLEXIBILITY WOVEN IN. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. THURSDAY. INTERVALS. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE CHEST AND HIPS, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN SHORT SHARP STATIONS. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. THURSDAY INTERVALS DONE. CHEST OPEN. HIPS HONEST. BALANCE OWNED. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: STANDING CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. HANDS BEHIND YOU OR ON THE DOOR FRAME. GENTLY OPEN THE CHEST. SHOULDER BLADES EASY. BREATHE. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT FORCE IT.
exercises.speakStart: STANDING CHEST OPENERS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. OPEN THE CHEST. BREATHE. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT FORCE IT LIKE YOU ARE PRIZING OPEN A BLOODY STUCK WINDOW.

exercises.name: KNEELING HIP FLEXOR STRETCH
exercises.cue: HALF KNEEL. BACK KNEE DOWN. GENTLY SHIFT FORWARD UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE BACK HIP. TALL TORSO. HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. BREATHE. NO BOUNCING.
exercises.speakStart: KNEELING HIP FLEXOR STRETCHES. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. HALF KNEEL. SHIFT FORWARD. FEEL THE FRONT OF THAT BACK HIP. THIS IS YOUR HIP OPENER. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A BLOODY PISTON.

exercises.name: STEP-UP
exercises.cue: LOW STAIR. STEP UP DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL. STEP DOWN CONTROLLED. ALTERNATE LEGS. INTERVAL STATION. STEADY CADENCE. LIGHT HAND ON A RAIL IF YOU NEED IT.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. THREE ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL. ALTERNATE LEGS. THIS IS YOUR INTERVAL. DO NOT STOMP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY ELEPHANT.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. CATCH YOUR BREATH. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HIGH PLANK ON THE FLOOR OR HANDS ON A LOW STAIR. DRIVE ONE KNEE IN THEN THE OTHER. SHORT SHARP INTERVAL. HIPS LEVEL. DO NOT BOUNCE THE BOTTOM.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. THREE ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. DRIVE THE KNEES. HIPS LEVEL. SHORT SHARP INTERVAL. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY SEAL ON THE ROCKS.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STEP. ABOUT FORTY INCHES. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER CHEST TOWARD THE STEP. PRESS UP CLEAN. LIGHT STRENGTH. DO NOT DROP THE STEP HEIGHT.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STEP. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER AND PRESS. LIGHT STRENGTH. DO NOT CHEAT THE HEIGHT LIKE A BLOODY TAX DODGER.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG STAND
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. ONE FOOT OFF THE FLOOR. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. LIGHT FINGERTIPS ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. EYES FORWARD. OWN IT.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG STANDS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH LEG. ONE FOOT UP. SOFT KNEE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TOPPLE LIKE A BLOODY DRUNK AT CLOSING TIME.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SWITCH LEGS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. ARMS UP. KNEES BENT. EXTEND OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG SLOW. LOW BACK PRESSED TO THE FLOOR. LIGHT CORE FINISH. CONTROLLED. NO ARCHING.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. LOW BACK GLUED DOWN. LIGHT FINISH. DO NOT ARCH LIKE A BLOODY BANANA.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE CORE QUIET. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUGS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
